mapper.sql: SELECT batch_id, drug_id, batch_no, supplier_name, production_date, expiry_date, inbound_qty, available_qty, purchase_price, warehouse_location, batch_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM clinic_drug_batch
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clinic_drug_batch (drug_id, batch_no, supplier_name, production_date, expiry_date, inbound_qty, available_qty, purchase_price, warehouse_location, batch_status, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{drugId}, #{batchNo}, #{supplierName}, #{productionDate}, #{expiryDate}, #{inboundQty}, #{availableQty}, #{purchasePrice}, #{warehouseLocation}, #{batchStatus}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: WHERE available_qty > 0 AND expiry_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ORDER BY expiry_date
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM clinic_drug_batch WHERE batch_id IN #{id}
